note: S0 target contract for canonical publication. Part III and V1 remain authoritative for the shipping implementation until approval and the staged implementation gates. This draft does not assert that the generator or any runtime client implements V2.

baseline.evidenceTransfer: A different family or revision requires its own applicable type, compiler, transport and runtime gates. Echo acceptance is not physical acceptance.

bool.decoding: Use the template's byte offset and bit information. Do not assume packed or byte-per-member storage.
bool.arrays: Template DWORD storage is expanded to logical Boolean elements only with the manifest's logical type, lower bound and element count.

int64.jsonEncoding: exact decimal string; never a floating-point intermediate

float64.literalRule: Generated values must preserve declared precision. The measured untyped decimal literal rounded to REAL before LREAL assignment; that form does not qualify a full-precision LREAL initializer.
float64.pendingAcceptance: Qualify a full-precision initializer on the next probe or the first surface that uses it.

duration_ms.reason: Matches Core's width and units directly. Native TIME32 is microseconds with insufficient range; native TIME is 64-bit microseconds and requires normalization and wider published storage.
duration_ms.rule: No client may infer duration from a DINT member name; the PLC manifest supplies its logical type.

string.logix: StringFamily with LEN DINT and DATA SINT[n]
string.widthSource: the owning Core or application declaration; no binding-wide narrowing
string.recognition: template shape, not a type-name prefix
string.validation: Reject invalid LEN or UTF-8. Reject generated literals exceeding the declared byte capacity.

timestamp.transportEncoding: ISO UTC with up to nine fractional digits; numeric zero for unset
timestamp.rule: Convert a microsecond wall-clock source to nanoseconds once in its owning provider. LINT-to-LDT assignment consumes a nanosecond value. Never assign a microsecond LINT directly as a timestamp.

publication.root: One controller-scope tag per deployed root, named exactly as its local browse name.
publication.module: A record declaring the standard Status contract; children are members named as their local schematic/instance names.
publication.discovery: Symbol object 0x6B, Template object 0x6C, and a validated PLC-resident manifest. No runtime station declaration or client-owned projection.
publication.templateReferences: Honor the structure bit and complete 12-bit template handle even when its low byte matches an atomic code.
publication.annotationRule: The generator derives annotations from the same declarations as the UDTs. Physical storage extent is not a logical BOOL-array extent.
publication.readAccess: Effective access to published values is Read Only.
publication.physicalAccessEncoding: Pending the additional size/naming/access probe; do not assume a read-only root permits a writable descendant.
publication.physicalManifestLayout: S2 work; legacy physical capacities and row layouts are not silently reinterpreted.

arrayBounds.rule: canonical index = physical element index + declared Core lower bound; packed BOOL arrays expand logical bits before applying that bound
arrayBounds.otherArrays: Retain their declared Core bounds. These five corrections are the complete equivalence allow-list.

transport.sourceTime: CIP provides no sample source timestamp; record receipt time without claiming clock synchronization.
transport.desktop: Generic CipSessionClient selected by cip://; read-only until a commissioned CIP Security session is proved.
transport.web: The same session client behind the Dart gateway; write-enabled deployments require recorded owner choice, authenticated principals, TLS and existing write-root/mailbox gates.
transport.mailbox: Serialize transactions; confirm all argument writes before a separate Sequence commit; require exact acknowledgement; never replay after timeout or reconnect.

unchangedLogicalContracts.scope: Logical semantics only. No legacy generated context or physical row layout becomes part of the canonical client contract by this reference.

openGates: Owner approval of this draft and the proposed Part III amendment
Additional structure-size, fragmentation, browse-name and effective-access probe before S2
Capacity Estimate and native scan-time evidence for each canonical surface
Physical controller and commissioned CIP Security acceptance at S7
